title: A proposal with identity and detail
description: At Vestigio Restauraciones, we specialize in the restoration and preservation of antique furniture and objects, bringing new life to pieces with history and emotional value. Through skilled craftsmanship, careful attention to detail, and respect for each material, we preserve the essence of every piece and help carry its legacy into the future.

panel.text: The idea of this project is to build a solid, elegant and scalable digital presence. Here we begin to structure content, visual identity and navigation experience.
